raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45700 reworded the fused draft KV dtype mismatch error and dropped the flag name, so `test_kv_cache_configurator_draft_gate.py` (weekly suite) no longer matches it. The mismatch happens when an `auto` draft resolves a KV dtype other than the one its region was sized in; setting `--speculative-draft-kv-cache-dtype` explicitly sizes the region in the draft's dtype, so the error names the flag again.

files.patch:
@@ -855,8 +855,9 @@ def _fused_draft_from_target_buffer(self, alloc):
                 raise ValueError(
                     f"Fused draft KV: the draft resolved its KV cache dtype to "
                     f"{self.kv_cache_dtype}, but its region inside the target's "
-                    f"pages holds {region_kv_dtype}. The draft KV dtype must "
-                    "match the dtype used to size its fused region."
+                    f"pages holds {region_kv_dtype}. Set "
+                    "--speculative-draft-kv-cache-dtype explicitly so the region "
+                    "is sized in the draft's KV dtype."
                 )
         return placement
